title: Accuracy and Political Bias of News Source Credibility Ratings by Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to rate the credibility of various left-leaning and right-leaning news websites, calculating an 'LLM rating bias score' by comparing model ratings to human expert ratings, and measuring the difference in these scores across the political spectrum. The study also evaluates the impact of assigning specific partisan roles (Democrat, Republican, or Independent) to the models via system prompts.
